# Floogic UI — Full Technical API & Agent Reference (`floogic-ui`)

> Comprehensive, token-driven, machine-readable reference for AI coding agents generating React interfaces with `floogic-ui`.

---

## 1. Architectural Principles & Rules

### Rule 1: Compound Component API
All multi-part components are exposed strictly via static properties attached to the main compound root component.
- **Pattern**: `<Parent>` contains `<Parent.Child1>`, `<Parent.Child2>`, etc.
- **DO NOT** attempt to import child components directly (`import { CardContent }` is invalid).
- **Export Syntax**: `export const Card = Object.assign(CardRoot, { Content: CardContent, Heading: CardHeading, ... })`

### Rule 2: StyleX Styling Engine & Native Overrides
Components accept StyleX overrides via the `stylex?: stylex.StyleXStyles` prop.
- Inside components, styles are resolved using `mergeStyles(...)` combining StyleX, native CSS class names (`className="..."`), and inline styles (`style={{ ... }}`).
- Both `className` and `style` props are fully supported and forwarded to underlying HTML elements for seamless native integration.

### Rule 3: Strict Token Hierarchy
No hardcoded raw numbers, hex colors, or font names.
- All values must reference design tokens exported by `@floogic/ui/tokens` (or `@floogic/ui`):
  `import { colors, spacing, shape, borders, fonts, fontSizes, fontWeights, elevation, durations, easings } from '@floogic/ui/tokens'`
  (or granular subpaths like `@floogic/ui/tokens/colors.stylex`)

### Rule 4: Accessibility & Radix Primitives
Underneath, interactive components (Modal, Select, Popover, Accordion, CheckboxGroup, RadioGroup, Tabs, Tooltip, HoverCard) wrap Radix UI primitives.
- All standard HTML attributes (`id`, `aria-*`, `data-*`, `onClick`, `onKeyDown`) and Radix props (`open`, `defaultOpen`, `onOpenChange`, `value`, `onValueChange`) are inherited and supported.

---

## 2. Complete Component API Catalog

### Accordion
- **Compound API**: `<Accordion type="single"|"multiple">`, `<Accordion.Item>`, `<Accordion.Trigger>`, `<Accordion.Content>`

### Alert & AlertGlobal
- **Alert**: `<Alert tone="error"|"warning"|"success"|"information"|"neutral">`, `<Alert.Icon />`, `<Alert.Heading>`, `<Alert.Description>`, `<Alert.Actions>`

### Avatar
- **Compound API**: `<Avatar size="small"|"medium"|"large">`, `<Avatar.Image />`, `<Avatar.Fallback>`, `<Avatar.Badge><BadgeDot status="online" /></Avatar.Badge>`, `<Avatar.Group limit={3}>`

### Badge, BadgeCount & BadgeDot
- **Badge**: `<Badge tone="brand"|"neutral"|"success"|"warning"|"error">`, `<Badge.Label>`, `<Badge.Icon>`
- **BadgeCount**: `<BadgeCount count={12} max={99} />`
- **BadgeDot**: `<BadgeDot status="online"|"busy"|"away"|"offline"|"notification" />`

### Button & ButtonGroup
- **Button Props**: `variant?: 'primary'|'secondary'|'tertiary'`, `tone?: 'brand'|'neutral'|'destructive'|'inverse'`, `size?: 'small'|'medium'|'large'`
- **Button Subcomponents**: `<Button.Label>`, `<Button.Icon>`
- **ButtonGroup**: `<ButtonGroup><Button ... /></ButtonGroup>`

### Card
- **Compound API**: `<Card variant="elevated"|"outlined"|"flat">`, `<Card.Media />`, `<Card.Content>`, `<Card.Heading>`, `<Card.Description>`, `<Card.Footer>`

### CheckboxGroup
- **Compound API**: `<CheckboxGroup value={[...]} onValueChange={...}>`, `<CheckboxGroup.Label>`, `<CheckboxGroup.Item value="...">`, `<CheckboxGroup.Hint>`, `<CheckboxGroup.Error>`

### DatePicker & Divider
- **DatePicker**: `<DatePicker date={date} onDateChange={setDate} />`
- **Divider**: `<Divider orientation="horizontal"|"vertical" />`

### Drawer
- **Compound API**: `<Drawer open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>`, `<Drawer.Content position="left"|"right"|"bottom">`, `<Drawer.Header>`, `<Drawer.Title>`, `<Drawer.CloseButton aria-label="Close" />`, `<Drawer.Body>`, `<Drawer.Footer>`

### Modal
- **Compound API**: `<Modal open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>`, `<Modal.Content size="small"|"medium"|"large">`, `<Modal.Header>`, `<Modal.Title>`, `<Modal.CloseButton aria-label="Close" />`, `<Modal.Body>`, `<Modal.Footer>`

### Select
- **Compound API**: `<Select value={val} onValueChange={setVal}>`, `<Select.Label>`, `<Select.Trigger placeholder="..." />`, `<Select.Content>`, `<Select.Item value="...">`

### Switch
- **Compound API**: `<Switch>`, `<Switch.Label>`, `<Switch.Field checked={val} onCheckedChange={setVal} />`

### Tabs
- **Compound API**: `<Tabs defaultValue="tab1">`, `<Tabs.List>`, `<Tabs.Item value="tab1">`, `<Tabs.Panel value="tab1">`

### TextArea & TextInput
- **TextInput**: `<TextInput required>`, `<TextInput.Label>`, `<TextInput.Field placeholder="..." value={val} onChange={...} />`
- **TextArea**: `<TextArea>`, `<TextArea.Label>`, `<TextArea.Field placeholder="..." value={val} onChange={...} />`

### Toast & Tooltip
- **Toast**: `<Toast open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>`, `<Toast.Title>`, `<Toast.Description>`, `<Toast.Close />`
- **Tooltip**: `<Tooltip>`, `<Tooltip.Trigger asChild>`, `<Tooltip.Content>`

### Typography
- **Props**: `variant?: 'h1'|'h2'|'h3'|'h4'|'h5'|'h6'|'body'|'caption'`, `color?: 'strong'|'weak'|'brand'|'danger'`
